:bar_chart: *Brands Portal Test Coverage Audit — last 24h*

Summary: 10 PRs merged (1 release-only) — 5 with full coverage, 4 with gaps

*:red_circle: Gaps (priority)*
- [High] feat(orders): [3/3] order detail items table alignment and substitute modal BRAND-3043 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928>) — `src/pages/orders/detail/catalog-select-modal/index.tsx` — new LD-flag branch (`AVAILABLE_FOR_SAMPLE_FLAG_KEY`) + offer-selection state changed `onConfirm` to emit `wholesaleVariantId`; directory has zero test files.
- [High] (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928>) — `src/pages/orders/detail/items-table/use-item-actions.ts` — `handleSubstitute` now writes `wholesaleVariantId` into the upsert mutation payload; no test references `useItemActions` anywhere in the repo.
- [High] (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928>) — `src/pages/orders/detail/catalog-select-modal/columns.tsx` — +192 lines of offer-row rendering, sample/case derivation and `onSelectOffer` wiring, fully untested.
- [Medium] (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928>) — `src/pages/orders/detail/items-table/use-columns.tsx` — +71/−34 to cell rendering and column shape, no co-located spec (contrast: the sibling `create/use-columns.tsx` change in #927 *is* covered via `create-products-card.test.tsx`).
- [Medium] feat(menu): add Dutchie POS ordering guidance BRAND-3663 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/939|#939>) — `src/pages/public-brand-menu/public-wholesale-menu-route.tsx` — new `guidanceAccepted` redirect guard is only asserted at the `App.test.tsx` route level; the co-located route test renders without outlet context, so the new branch never executes.
- [Medium] (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/939|#939>) — `src/pages/public-brand-menu/public-pos-guidance-route.tsx` — new route component with an `acceptGuidance()` + `navigate('order')` handler, no co-located spec.
- [Medium] (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/931|#931>, <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/939|#939>) — `e2e/tests/` — two new public-facing wholesale PO flows shipped with no Playwright spec; `e2e/tests/` still only holds `catalog`, `intelligence`, `promotions`, `settings`, `smoke`.
- [Low] feat(menu): build public PO editor and Add items modal BRAND-3661 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/931|#931>) — `src/pages/public-brand-menu/public-add-items-modal.tsx`, `public-order-editor-stage.tsx` — new files with no co-located spec, but exercised end-to-end (open → pending edits → confirm → submit) by `public-wholesale-menu-route.test.tsx`.
- [Low] feat(orders): [2/3] multi-offer catalog modal and order create items table BRAND-3043 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/927|#927>) — `src/pages/orders/create/price-cell.tsx` — input padding/width tweak plus a swap from `uomLabel` to `getItemUnitLabel`; the new helper has direct unit tests.
- [Low] feat(orders): [1/3] wholesale variants GraphQL ops, contracts, shared utils BRAND-3043 (<https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/926|#926>) — `jest/jest.setup.ts` — stray blank line only; the three `.gql` files were also reindented tabs-vs-spaces, no behavior change.

*:warning: Stale coverage risk*
- `src/pages/public-brand-menu/public-retailer-commerce-shell.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/939|#939> — test `public-retailer-commerce-shell.test.tsx` last updated before the window — new `outletContext` prop is passed to `<Outlet />`, test still asserts only the children-based shell and never checks context propagation.
- `src/pages/public-brand-menu/index.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/939|#939> — test `index.test.tsx` not touched — admission component now owns `guidanceAccepted` state, no test covers the accept→persist transition across nested routes.

- `src/pages/public-brand-menu/public-wholesale-menu-route.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/939|#939> — test `public-wholesale-menu-route.test.tsx` last updated in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/943|#943> (phone-field edit only) — redirect guard added after the test was written; `guidance` resolves to `null` under the test's render, silently skipping the branch.
- `src/pages/orders/detail/items-table/use-item-actions.ts` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928> — test not found — success copy also changed to "Item substituted. Quantities and pricing updated." with nothing asserting it.
- `src/pages/orders/detail/catalog-select-modal/index.tsx` + `columns.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928> — test not found — `onConfirm` arity grew to two args; no consumer test pins the new contract.
- `src/pages/orders/create/price-cell.tsx` changed in <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/927|#927> — test `price-cell.test.tsx` not touched — unit-label source swapped to the variant-aware helper; the test asserts only cents formatting, so the rendered per-unit label is unverified.

*:white_check_mark: Coverage added*
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/942|#942> — unit — `useOrderSubmit`: `isEditable` derivation, Confirmed vs Amended status selection on line-item edits, cache evict + refetch + success toast, and the mutation-rejection path.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/941|#941> — unit — `useOrderDetailData`: loading/error flags, raw `sourceChannel` passthrough, `displayStatus` derived from status + `actionRequiredBy`, empty-orderId skip, and network-only fetch policy.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/940|#940> — unit — order detail drawer: `cancel_order` filtered out of the Actions dropdown for public-menu orders, retained for cancellable Dutchie POS orders.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/943|#943> — unit — optional buyer phone end to end: yup schema accepts empty/whitespace but still rejects malformed, field label/required attrs, adapter omits `retailer.phone`, and route submission payload has no `phone` key.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/926|#926> — unit — `wholesaleVariantId`/`variantName` forwarding through `buildUpsertPurchaseOrderInput` and `mapItemsToMutationInput`, plus MOQ-based `requestedQuantity` prefill in `toCreateOrderItem` (incl. `minimumOrderQuantity` fallback and the 1-unit default).
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/927|#927> — unit — multi-offer catalog data shaping, new `nudge-utils` bulk-upgrade math, qty-cell clamping, variant badge/case metadata, Min/Max warnings, and the "Upgrade" click producing the correct item patch.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/931|#931> — unit — public order context/lines/search input, wholesale product grid helpers, `usePublicOrderSubmission`, and the Add-items pending → confirm → mutation-submit route flow.
- <https://github.com/GetDutchie/brands-portal/pull/928|#928> — unit — items-table row grouping/`getRowClassName` for variant sub-offers and the new `getItemDetailUnitLabel` sample/case/unit formatting.

logged in the ledger for a clean pickup next cycle. - `public-brand-menu/index.tsx` (PR #939 stale-risk, guidanceAccepted accept→persist transition across nested routes) — confirmed closeable, no blocker on the gap itself; logged in the ledger for a clean pickup next cycle.  *Needs a human — other (e2e-out-of-scope):* - Two new public wholesale PO flows (PR #931 public PO editor/Add-items modal, PR #939 Dutchie POS ordering guidance) shipped with zero Playwright coverage; e2e/tests/ still has no public-menu suite at all — e2e suite cannot execute in this constellation (armageddon-web stuck in 'waiting' on seed dependencies, and e2e/global-setup.ts's RAILS_ENV=test gate isn't satisfied in development mode, matching e2e/COVERAGE-GAPS.md's own documented blocker). First seen 2026-09-22.  *Already covered (report was stale/overstated):* - `public-brand-menu/public-add-items-modal.tsx` + `public-order-editor-stage.tsx` (PR #931, Low) — the report itself notes these are already exercised end-to-end (open → pending edits → confirm → submit) by the existing `public-wholesale-menu-route.test.tsx`; confirmed by reading that test. - `orders/create/price-cell.tsx` input padding/helper swap (PR #927, Low, the "gap" listing — distinct from the stale-risk entry above) — report itself notes the new helper has direct unit tests. - `jest/jest.setup.ts` (PR #926, Low) — stray blank line + `.gql` tabs-vs-spaces reindent only, no behavior change.  All other candidates from prior cycles remain tracked in the ledger (unchanged this cycle).
